title: Afterpay
description: Afterpay's official colour palette leads with Bondi Mint (#b2fce4), white (#ffffff), and black (#000000), complemented by Shell/Light Mint (#fffbf7), Midnight Blue (#00193a), Tasman Teal (#009e97), and mint variants (#90e4c8, #5b9e9b, #368071, #2d3f39). Hex and RGB are published on Afterpay's merchant brand tools colour palette page.
